title: RoboCop: Rogue City

game_settings.why: RoboCop's own FSR 3.0 frame generation never reaches OptiScaler (FSR FG input: 1.0 in gameplay even with the FSR upscaler); DLSS upscaling with the game's DLSS frame generation feeds XeFG through DLSS FG input (OptiPatcher exposes DLSS without spoofing).

note: FSR FG input needs the game's AMD frame generation; the game's FSR 3.0 FG may not reach OptiScaler.
